scope: Actual Vue components with simulated native IPC; native filesystem and config serialization tested separately
checks: Save as template captures the active unsaved editor rather than stale disk content
Variable preview expands title/date/time; a persistence failure keeps input and retries without a duplicate template
New note uses the library default; explicit template uses unique names, while explicit blank always stays blank
Rename preserves the default by ID; template dialogs fit six styles at two widths with normal animations
Quick note shares custom/default templates, confirms before replacing drafts, saves expanded content and prepares the next note
Cross-window catalog changes refresh available templates without replacing a draft, including a deleted active template
Deleting a custom template clears its library defaults without stale nested-map entries and keeps existing notes
